items.title: Cardinals Activate Garrett Williams from PUP List Before Preseason Finale

items.title: Arctos to Buy 10% of Atlanta Falcons at $10.6 Billion Valuation
items.one_line: Arthur Blank, who bought the Falcons for $545 million back in 2002, is set to cash out over $1 billion from a 10% stake while keeping full control.

items.one_line: Tua Tagovailoa's short pass to Drake London turned into a pick-six by Colts cornerback Justin Walley, lighting up social media with memes and fan jabs.

items.title: NFL Fans Debate Lamar Jackson, Harbaugh, and Ravens Super Bowl Hopes
items.one_line: Ravens fans are buzzing with dreams of a Super Bowl under John Harbaugh, while rivals fire back with stats and jabs. One fan summed it up: 'gonna be so mad if we win a SB with Harbaugh bro lol.'

items.title: Fans Debate Lamar Jackson vs Josh Allen in NFL QB Rankings
items.one_line: Ravens fans marveled at Lamar Jackson's precise deep ball to the Giants, with one calling his throws 'so pretty.' Bills supporters countered hard, claiming Josh Allen edges him in key seasons.

items.one_line: Dion Dawkins stonewalled Jared Verse's rushes all day, trading trash talk in a heated one-on-one drill that had both players grinning post-practice.

items.one_line: Packers radio hosts called Bears fans 'not very good,' citing a snowy 2016 loss to the 49ers. Chicago supporters fired back, defending their dedication through lean years.

items.title: Bears' Bagent Out Week-to-Week with Hamstring Injury Ahead of Bengals Practice
items.one_line: As the Bears geared up for a tough joint practice with the Bengals, backup QB Tyson Bagent's hamstring injury kept him sidelined at home with the team.

items.title: Burrow Demands Super Bowl Urgency in Tense Bengals-Bears Practice
items.one_line: Joe Burrow pushed back in a quick scuffle, then fired a big pass to Ja'Marr Chase, who made his loyalty clear: 'We just better fucking protect Joe.'

items.one_line: Joe Burrow grabbed his jersey after a late hit, sparking a quick scuffle that teammates shut down fast. Moments like that showed the edge in Thursday's heated joint practice.

items.one_line: Taylor Rapp, a battle-tested safety with 72 NFL starts, found a new home with the Denver Broncos on Thursday. It's the kind of quiet move that could pay big dividends down the road.

items.title: Lions Try Out Veteran Guards Hernandez and Tomlinson for Line Depth

items.one_line: A simple CBS Sports chart lists just three Packers starting quarterbacks since 1993: Favre, Rodgers, and Love. Fans across the division lit up with pride, shock, and plenty of rivalry banter.

items.one_line: Jake Elliott toed the ball through the uprights just twice out of five tries in training camp, even with the wind in his favor. Fans couldn't hide their disappointment.

items.title: Steelers Debate Keeping All Four Quarterbacks on Roster
